name: @zena-lang/wit-parser
description: WIT (WebAssembly Interface Types) parser for Zena

test:zena.#command: The lexer, the parser, the ported wasm-tools corpus and the component encoder, as Zena tests. Runs from the repository root, which is what the paths inside the tests are relative to and where the compiler finds the package map. The encoder tests need wasm-tools on PATH (the dev shell has it); regenerate their goldens with UPDATE_WIT_GOLDENS=1.

test:real-wit.#command: The pinned real-world WIT corpus, which lives outside the repository: `/` is preopened because the Nix corpus is a store path, and a test under `zena test` gets only the repository, the standard library and a scratch directory.

test:example.#command: Runs from the repo root because the compiler loads the package map from the working directory, and reaching the parser through that map is what this example exists to prove. Running it rather than only compiling it also exercises the parser end to end: it throws on a parse or resolve failure.
